case.title: Participant submission lasting 179 s fires

submissions.open_text: Our compound connection rarely fails, though bills arrive late.
Neighbours buy drums from a seller who delivers by motorbike.

case.why: 179 s is one second below the 180 s participant minimum, so too_fast must fire. An off-by-one or minute-rounding implementation (179/60 = 2.98, which rounds to 3) would miss it. The companion hal at 540 s is below the enumerator minimum but must not matter here. Other checks are quiet: there are 2 submissions only. Both points are inside Kondele. The times are 12:45 and 16:20 local. The texts are distinct. There is no voice note, and the device is used by one contributor.
